d:
Newly appointed Chief of Air Staff Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit Sunday identified operational readiness, restoring the Indian Air Force's sanctioned fighter squadron strength, self-reliance in platforms and weapon systems, and greater coordination among the three services as his key priorities.
A day after taking charge as the 29th Chief of Air Staff, Dixit outlined his vision for the IAF under the acronym 'VAYU', which stands for vigilance and operational readiness, atmanirbharta (self-reliance), yukti (tactical innovation) and unity of effort across the tri-services.
